The Kotlin SDK's Compose kit. Today it provides the boot shell, the gate, activation, sign-in with
a QR code, settings, devices, the update banner and prompt, and pack progress for native Android
apps. It is being rebuilt to the UI-kit specification as a Compose Multiplatform kit for Android
and desktop; until then, its reference is the kit's README, rendered whole below so there is
exactly one copy to keep current. The rest of the Kotlin SDK is on the
[Kotlin](/docs/build/sdks/kotlin/) page.

<KitFacts kit="compose" />

## Piecemeal

`PolarisKeyApp(client) { }` is the one call. To place the screens yourself, hold a
`PolarisGateState(client.gateActions(), scope)` and call its `start()`; then:

- `PolarisGate(state) { }` gates your content and shows the right screen for the license.
- `PolarisActivationScreen` is the activation form on its own, drawn from the state's `activation`
  flow.
- `PolarisDevices(PolarisDevicesState(client.devicesActions(), scope))` lists, renames and removes
  devices.
- `PolarisGraceBanner` is the offline-grace banner, for a screen that shows it over your content.
- `rememberPolarisLicense()` reads the live license state anywhere under `PolarisKeyApp` or
  `PolarisKeyProvider`.
